547a4a98a0bbb90ad401.en: A clause has a subject and a verb. A main clause makes sense on its own.
547a4a98a0bbb90ad401.id: Klausa (clause) punya subjek dan kata kerja. Induk kalimat (main clause) bisa dipahami walaupun berdiri sendiri.

50b104eea2217452a9e2.en: A subordinate clause starts with a conjunction such as when, because, although, if or unless.
50b104eea2217452a9e2.id: Anak kalimat (subordinate clause) dimulai dengan kata penghubung (conjunction) seperti when, because, although, if, atau unless.

bd416eef0428b0401649.en: Put them together to make a complex sentence.
bd416eef0428b0401649.id: Gabungkan keduanya untuk membuat kalimat majemuk (complex sentence).

fa5d028b74f6f2f68609.en: If the subordinate clause comes first, put a comma after it.
fa5d028b74f6f2f68609.id: Kalau anak kalimat ada di depan, taruh koma setelahnya.

b68628dba085caf6c634.en: Choose the conjunction that shows the right link: a reason, a time, a condition or a contrast.
b68628dba085caf6c634.id: Pilih kata penghubung yang menunjukkan hubungan yang tepat: alasan, waktu, syarat, atau pertentangan.

cf5af4593b864198f18a.en: Although shows a contrast: Although it was raining, we played outside.
cf5af4593b864198f18a.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan: Although it was raining, we played outside.

2df8b86df1cece347e1e.en: Because joins the two clauses and gives the reason.
2df8b86df1cece347e1e.id: Because menghubungkan kedua klausa (clause) dan memberi alasan.

a364d147f5a53c465cf9.en: Because joins the main clause we stayed inside to the subordinate clause it was raining. It gives a reason.
a364d147f5a53c465cf9.id: Because menghubungkan induk kalimat (main clause) we stayed inside dengan anak kalimat (subordinate clause) it was raining. Kata itu memberi alasan.

39129a4b6e6c707083ca.en: Although shows a contrast. It was hot, which makes wearing a jacket surprising.
39129a4b6e6c707083ca.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan. Cuacanya panas, jadi memakai jaket itu mengejutkan.

29e0fb661f47d6b9434a.en: Each subordinate clause adds a condition, a time or a reason to the main clause, and the whole sentence makes sense.
29e0fb661f47d6b9434a.id: Setiap anak kalimat (subordinate clause) menambahkan syarat, waktu, atau alasan pada induk kalimat (main clause), dan seluruh kalimatnya masuk akal.

d00fb96a021f5537cb12.en: The cat slept, we walked home and Dewi finished her painting make sense alone. The others begin with conjunctions and need a main clause.
d00fb96a021f5537cb12.id: The cat slept, we walked home, dan Dewi finished her painting masuk akal walau berdiri sendiri. Yang lainnya dimulai dengan kata hubung (conjunction) dan memerlukan induk kalimat (main clause).

399dd5409ae53023eed9.en: When the sun set is a subordinate clause and the bats flew out of the cave is the main clause, so it is a complex sentence.
399dd5409ae53023eed9.id: When the sun set adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause) dan the bats flew out of the cave adalah induk kalimat (main clause), jadi itu kalimat majemuk bertingkat (complex sentence).

84d24444ba22fe60f8e3.en: Unless means except if, so you can only swim when an adult is with you. Until would also work.
84d24444ba22fe60f8e3.id: Unless berarti kecuali kalau, jadi kamu hanya boleh berenang saat ada orang dewasa bersamamu. Until juga bisa dipakai.

5848bdd615e4303f1e57.en: The subordinate clause Although the test was hard comes first, so a comma separates it from the main clause.
5848bdd615e4303f1e57.id: Anak kalimat (subordinate clause) Although the test was hard berada di depan, jadi koma memisahkannya dari induk kalimat (main clause).

7ce9d2563f4370eb0466.en: Although the film was long, we enjoyed every minute. The although clause can also come second: We enjoyed every minute although the film was long.
7ce9d2563f4370eb0466.id: Although the film was long, we enjoyed every minute. Klausa dengan although juga bisa berada di belakang: We enjoyed every minute although the film was long.

40a87f46a0f374b1990f.en: Before the match started, If you finish early and As soon as the bell rang are subordinate clauses at the start, followed by commas.
40a87f46a0f374b1990f.id: Before the match started, If you finish early, dan As soon as the bell rang adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause) di awal, yang diikuti koma.

1c713a0d1319c455c336.en: When we arrived and because it was a holiday are both subordinate clauses. The museum was closed is the main clause.
1c713a0d1319c455c336.id: When we arrived dan because it was a holiday keduanya adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause). The museum was closed adalah induk kalimat (main clause).

0bbe86cba87e72dfca56.en: Because introduces the reason. It makes the second part a subordinate clause.
0bbe86cba87e72dfca56.id: Because mengawali alasan. Kata itu membuat bagian kedua menjadi anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

a7723cd02baaa6b4aad6.en: If the rain stops needs the main clause to make sense, so it is the subordinate clause.
a7723cd02baaa6b4aad6.id: If the rain stops memerlukan induk kalimat (main clause) supaya masuk akal, jadi itu adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

846fe9d5fc74cd5d4b27.en: Although she was tired is the subordinate clause. A comma follows it, then the main clause.
846fe9d5fc74cd5d4b27.id: Although she was tired adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Setelahnya ada koma, lalu induk kalimat (main clause).

8c52f3efcf09060cf430.en: And, but, so and or join main clauses. Because, although, while and unless begin subordinate clauses.
8c52f3efcf09060cf430.id: And, but, so, dan or menghubungkan induk kalimat (main clause). Because, although, while, dan unless mengawali anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

74d5dbcc3560a87dd9dc.en: Because gives a reason, although shows contrast, unless means if not, and until shows an end point in time.
74d5dbcc3560a87dd9dc.id: Because memberi alasan, although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, unless berarti if not (kalau tidak), dan until menunjukkan batas akhir waktu.

0649a193007953a60cf6.en: Unless you hurry is the subordinate clause, then the main clause tells what happens.
0649a193007953a60cf6.id: Unless you hurry adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause), lalu induk kalimat (main clause) menjelaskan apa yang terjadi.

c8cfec6cd58a008ceb81.en: Unless means if not. You will not pass if you do not practise.
c8cfec6cd58a008ceb81.id: Unless berarti if not (kalau tidak). Kamu tidak akan lulus kalau kamu tidak berlatih.

401cbdde6e7f73410858.en: The main clause makes sense alone. Here, the subordinate clause begins with a conjunction.
401cbdde6e7f73410858.id: Induk kalimat (main clause) masuk akal walau berdiri sendiri. Di sini, anak kalimat (subordinate clause) dimulai dengan kata hubung (conjunction).

db424afb4126a0400a18.en: Until shows the time when Tom stopped reading.
db424afb4126a0400a18.id: Until menunjukkan waktu saat Tom berhenti membaca.

52a4669358b0cd46fe09.en: Although shows contrast. Until shows how long he waited.
52a4669358b0cd46fe09.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan. Until menunjukkan berapa lama dia menunggu.

c3a1b0be440b5a0241ef.en: Because and while start subordinate clauses. Here, and and but join main clauses.
c3a1b0be440b5a0241ef.id: Because dan while mengawali anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Di sini, and dan but menghubungkan induk kalimat (main clause).

5abda0fb7f39ae39f5af.en: But joins two main clauses, so it is a compound sentence. The others each have a subordinate clause.
5abda0fb7f39ae39f5af.id: But menghubungkan dua induk kalimat (main clause), jadi itu kalimat majemuk setara (compound sentence). Kalimat lainnya masing-masing punya anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

a4c928d24f099b07b463.en: Because the electricity went out leaves us waiting for the main clause, so it is a fragment.
a4c928d24f099b07b463.id: Because the electricity went out membuat kita menunggu induk kalimat (main clause), jadi itu adalah potongan kalimat (fragment).

d7f9ecab93efeeea271a.en: It shows contrast with although and gives the real reason with because.
d7f9ecab93efeeea271a.id: Kalimat itu menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan dengan although dan memberi alasan sebenarnya dengan because.

94ec9ff14661b44705aa.en: Since can give a reason. It was late is the reason they went home.
94ec9ff14661b44705aa.id: Since bisa memberi alasan. It was late adalah alasan mereka pulang.

15e3c4ec9e6cb71f6d8a.en: We can go out unless it rains means we can go out if it does not rain.
15e3c4ec9e6cb71f6d8a.id: We can go out unless it rains berarti kita boleh keluar kalau tidak hujan.

476337b13bf216be558f.en: Although she was tired is a subordinate clause. It needs a main clause such as she kept running.
476337b13bf216be558f.id: Although she was tired adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Bagian itu memerlukan induk kalimat (main clause) seperti she kept running.

2888ae100ad345ec90b1.en: A subordinate clause depends on a main clause to make sense. For example, because I was hungry needs I ate lunch.
2888ae100ad345ec90b1.id: Anak kalimat (subordinate clause) memerlukan induk kalimat (main clause) supaya masuk akal. Misalnya, because I was hungry memerlukan I ate lunch.

4340a53f1808bedfa45b.en: The main clause is I ate lunch because it can stand alone. Because I was hungry is the subordinate clause.
4340a53f1808bedfa45b.id: Induk kalimatnya (main clause) adalah I ate lunch karena bagian itu bisa berdiri sendiri. Because I was hungry adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

d5595c685895904b9c02.en: I will help you makes sense alone. If you ask is the subordinate clause.
d5595c685895904b9c02.id: I will help you masuk akal walau berdiri sendiri. If you ask adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

11c57f345dc486b35980.en: Although shows that the two ideas are surprising together.
11c57f345dc486b35980.id: Although menunjukkan bahwa kedua gagasan itu mengejutkan kalau digabung.
